entities.name: Raklan
entities.description: Garruk's father, a taskmage and farmer.

entities.name: Garruk
entities.description: Raklan's son, taught seedsprouting, who later avenged his father.

entities.name: Lord Faldus
entities.description: Lord whose men tried to recruit Garruk.

entities.name: sheriff
entities.description: Sheriff who arrested, tortured and killed Raklan; later impaled by Garruk's beast.

events.quote: Raklan taught his young son Garruk how to grow plants using taskmage magic

events.summary: Lord Faldus' men come to recruit Garruk; Raklan refuses and orders Garruk into the woods.
events.quote: Raklan refused to give him up, ordering Garruk to run into the woods.

events.summary: The sheriff arrests Raklan, tortures and eventually kills him.
events.quote: Raklan was tortured by the Sheriff and was eventually killed.

events.summary: Years later Garruk avenges Raklan by having a beast impale the Sheriff.
events.quote: Garruk would avenge his death years later by having one of his beasts impale the Sheriff on its horn.
